title: Reverse a String
description: Write a function that takes a string and returns it reversed. For example, 'hello' should become 'olleh' and 'Python' should become 'nohtyP'.
instructions: Complete the reverse_string function so it returns the input string in reverse order.
hints: Think about how you would read the string backwards.
In Python, you can reverse a string using slicing with a step of -1: s[::-1]
You could also build the reversed string character by character using a loop.
